description: This Java source file defines the StatusSupplierActor class, an Akka actor responsible for providing status and health information of an ActorSystem within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles specific commands to retrieve system status or health and communicates with associated components in the system.

classes.name: StatusSupplierActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that supplies status and health information of the ActorSystem, designed to be started as a root actor for consistent system identification across microservices.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props for configuring an instance of StatusSupplierActor with the specified root actor name.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling logic: responds to status and health retrieval commands, and handles unknown or unsupported messages.
